upstream_recipe.optimizer: AdamW over ALL requires_grad parameters, one weight-decay group including biases/norm/embeddings
upstream_recipe.gradient_clipping: not applied by official fine-tune loop
upstream_recipe.precision: upstream bfloat16 autocast; local float32 MPS must be declared as an adaptation

warmup_source_behavior.construction: LinearLR(start_factor=0.1,end_factor=1.0,total_iters=10); optimizer LR is scaled on scheduler construction
warmup_source_behavior.step_order: optimizer update -> validation/checkpoint/earlystop -> if epoch<10: warmup.step(); otherwise dummy plateau scheduler because lr_scheduler=False
warmup_source_behavior.finding: The pinned implementation stops warmup after nine scheduler.step calls, so it holds 0.91*base_lr from update10 onward. Do not silently replace with cosine or a conventional warmup reaching1.0.
warmup_source_behavior.recommendation: Preserve the literal pinned trajectory for this first adaptation and log LR used for every optimizer update. A corrected trajectory is a different declared local recipe, not a silent compatibility fix.

episode_sampler.frequency: new episode each optimizer update; exactly one episode batch per step
algorithm: Use a private seeded numpy RandomState.

For classification with smallest class>=5, randomly permute all current training rows, then take the first split of StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=the same rng). Otherwise use random train_test_split(test_size=.2).
Take support[:min(16384,len(support))] and query[:min(1024,len(query))]. The original preceding permutation makes truncated rows randomized.
DatasetFinetune additionally rng.choice(support_count,size=support_count,replace=False) when the support already fits. Apply the same permutation to X/y/IDs.
Assert support/query original row IDs are disjoint after all sampling; query targets are used solely for the loss.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Fit once on the complete applicable training split before episode generation, never on validation/test or separately on each episode. Model internal quantile embedding remains support-conditioned.
preprocessing.note: runner QT_TASK_GATE is only a gate for an explicitly enabled optional quantile view; default ViewSpec.quantile_transform=False. Do not accidentally enable it on small binary tasks.

loss_and_label_mask.training: CrossEntropy over all native10 output logits with query targets0/1; no [:2] truncation before training CE.
loss_and_label_mask.validation_prediction: Extract actual two class logits through fitted preprocessor mapping, then softmax and binary-class logloss.
loss_and_label_mask.mask: Core accepts x_support,y_support,x_query and padding masks only; it constructs query-label embeddings from its learned y_mask, never y_query. Do not concatenate query labels into support.
loss_and_label_mask.padding: Batch1 unpadded episode can use all-false feature/support/query padding masks with correct shapes. Padded labels must follow upstream ignore/mask conventions.
loss_and_label_mask.binary_mapping: Encode true training labels consistently as0/1. Class shuffling disabled in the fixed recipe; if ever enabled, invert it before scoring.

local_nested_protocol.declaration: Single-model resource-conscious adaptation, not the author8-bag benchmark recipe.
local_nested_protocol.selection: Outertrain -> fixed stratified80% gradient-training and20% monitoring. Fit preprocessing on innertrain only; initialize from the SHA-verified public checkpoint. Evaluate step0, then steps1..50 using innertrain-only support and inner-validation queries. Select strict minimum finite logloss, earliest step on ties, allowing0.
local_nested_protocol.refit: Discard selection weights/optimizer/preprocessor. Reload original checkpoint, refit preprocessing on all outertrain, reset RNG and optimizer/warmup, and train exactly selected_steps episodes. For selected0 perform no gradient updates. Use complete outertrain as final prediction support; no outerval labels or old holdout labels ever enter support.
local_nested_protocol.final_export: Repeat selection within full labeled8693, freshrefit full8693 for selected_steps, then test4277 queries against full labeled8693 context. Do not select steps on test labels.
local_nested_protocol.author_heldout_support_rule: The official bag heldout-in-support rule does NOT authorize adding our outer validation or old holdout labels. Only our current outertrain can be final context.
local_nested_protocol.seeds: Reset Python random, numpy global, torch and MPS RNG plus private episode RandomState at each fresh stage. Record seeds and support/query ID hashes. A deterministic validation support order with a separate/no evaluation RNG is a declared reproducibility adaptation: upstream evaluation can consume the same private RNG through support permutations.
local_nested_protocol.early_stopping_difference: Recommend evaluating the full0..50 range as requested; unlike stock patience40 this can evaluate all50 despite an early plateau. Record this as local adaptation.
local_nested_protocol.checkpoint_integrity: Verify pretrained SHA for every fresh fit; never reuse an earlier fold adapted model or optimizer state. Clone stored best/state tensors rather than retaining live state_dict aliases.

resource_decision.probe: Root schedules device tests. A512support/128query backward only checks operator compatibility. Need representative2966/742 and3708/928 episodic backward+AdamW update memory; final export has larger6954/1024 episode. Also measure full-support validation inference eachstep.
resource_decision.no_assumed_MPS_support: Official package requires CUDA and its fast loop contains CUDA-specific preflight/cache logic. Local float32 SDPA/backend adaptation must be tested and identified.
resource_decision.if_not_feasible: Run and report zero-shot only, with adaptation explicitly untested. Do not silently shrink support/query or substitute shorter training and call it the same recipe.
